notes.title: OUT NOW | The Isle Tide Hotel
notes.notes:
Today is the grand opening of The Isle Tide Hotel! Expect a live-action, interactive mystery movie about an absent father who must rescue his teenage daughter from an eclectic cult before their final night at the Isle Tide Hotel. 

Think a British Twin Peaks with a Wes Anderson aesthetic! Or, if that doesn't convince you, how about a grittier Knives Out? There's so much to explore and discover about The Isle Tide Hotel that one playthrough won't get close to telling the whole story.

[previewyoutube=_lSv_RQkKi8;full][/previewyoutube]

Why is your daughter estranged in the first place? Will you join the cult to save her? How will you interact with the bizarre people you meet? Each playthrough of The Isle Tide Hotel's branching narrative will be completely different, with seven main endings in your mission to rescue the daughter you've never met. Just remember… don't break the Etiquettes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/9c782eeaef7589cd09a03a1731c10d20a6bd524d.jpg[/img]

Created by brother-sister director-producer combo Harry and Grace Chadwick of Interflix Media, the themes of The Isle Tide Hotel draw on the transformational journey of parenthood and the unique paths that can be taken when dealing with family dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/0c5302aecad1055167a43dac51c405e601a451b2.jpg[/img]

You don't want to miss our biggest production yet, with a cast including UK icons from shows including Game of Thrones, Call the Midwife and Happy Valley.

It's our biggest project yet. Every decision affects the story and you'll have to keep an eye out for clues - it's on you if you miss something important.

[b]The Isle Tide Hotel is OUT NOW on PC, Epic, Mac, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/a59eb786b5c4cf1285589db297e8668aeb4228a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mia and the Dragon Princess OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Wales Interactive, have launched interactive, buddy-action movie Mia and the Dragon Princess. Unravel the mystery with Mia, a plucky bartender whose life is thrown into chaos when a mysterious woman turns up at her workplace, on the run from a group of violent thugs.

[previewyoutube=0YcSREYCCP4;full][/previewyoutube]

Mia and the Dragon Princess is now available on PC, Epic, Mac, PS5, PS4, Xbox One, Series X|S, Switch, iOS and Android. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42624485/d3b531790787863a5029bc76b71f6dd0657e301f.jpg[/img]

 
[b]Features[/b]
•	Featuring action designed by world-renowned fight coordinator, Marcus Shakesheff (WonderWoman, Hanna, Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, Batman: Arkham Asylum, Pennyworth, Guardians of the Galaxy, Game of Thrones)
•	Featuring fight stunts by Taekwondo instructor and content creator with over 700M views, Aaron Gassor aka 'Ginger Ninja Trickster'
•	Real time Attribute Tracking that evolves based on your choices and influences the story
•	Multi-optional storytelling with 10 different outcomes
•	Starring Paul McGann (Doctor Who, Alien 3, Withnail & I), Brian McCardie (Time, Rob Roy) and MyAnna Buring (The Witcher, Ripper Street), Dita Tantang and Noa Bleeker.
•	Guest appearance by Daz Black (DazGames) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42624485/e46595f81fd3686eea42fd4630eabf884dea18f6.jpg[/img]

[b]Synopsis[/b]

Mia dreams of adventure, but her feeling of responsibility to her workmates – who have become her surrogate family – keeps her working at a job she’s bored of, living a life she didn’t want. When a mysterious woman (Marshanda) turns up scared and on the run, Mia’s decision to take her under her wing and try to discover her identity leads her down a path of intrigue, mystery and danger. 
 
When a group of thugs, led by the quietly terrifying, Walsh (Paul McGann) turns up at the bar, Mia and her co-workers are taken hostage along with a group of customers. When Mia’s boss, Matthew (Brian McCardie) is injured, the stakes are raised and the struggle becomes real when Mia and the group end up on the run and battling for their lives. 
 
The viewer’s choices will guide Mia through the adventure and will determine her fate, as well as that of the whole group. Throughout the game, your interactions could increase your knowledge around the identity of the mysterious woman, but the way Mia deals with the rest of the group will also have an impact, so each choice needs to be carefully considered.   

[b]Mia and the Dragon Princess is published by Wales Interactive and developed by Wales Interactive, Good Gate Media and Dead Pixel Productions. [/b]

notes.title: Community Request: Improved Skip Function
notes.notes:
Dear community, 

After our last post discussing the Skip feature, we've had a lot of feedback on what you think about it and how we could improve it to make your multiple playthroughs more enjoyable. We are proud to announce that we have listened to your feedback and the new and improved Skip feature is now live!

[b]What's changed?[/b]

Once you have experienced the story for the first time, you will be able to skip [b]any[/b] video. Additionally, if you have [b]not[/b] seen the video before (even those that are similar but will have additional content) you as the player will be in control and get to choose whether to skip or not. 

To do this, you simply have to [b]hold[/b] down the skip button to move on. For any videos you have not seen, when you hold to skip you will see the warning "THIS SCENE CONTAINS NEW INFORMATION. ARE YOU SURE YOU WANT TO SKIP?".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/7ac7defdc448a4616687e5499704297c8b916624.gif[/img]

As always, we love to hear from you. Drop a comment below and if you haven't already, leave a review on the store page to let others know what you think!

Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: To Skip or Not to Skip
notes.notes:
Hello!

First and foremost we would like to thank you, everyone, who has been playing recently, we have enjoyed watching your playthroughs, reading your feedback and have been taking notes of all your suggestions.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1628130/view/3090038532608169285

One feature we recognise could have been explained better is the Skip function. To some, it may appear as if it's bugged or broken but the skip feature is only granted [b]after[/b] your first playthrough of the game. It's a reward for your completion and to make it easier to fastrack past the scenes you've watched to unlock the hidden clues/stories or collect achievements you missed.

Be careful what you skip! Some scenes may look similar to ones you've already watched but they can most definitely end differently. There is more information and possible evidence up for grabs in the new scenes that will help you find the killer. Even some extra story information for each character at the end of the game.

We hope this helps and thank you again for playing! 

- Wales Interactive Team

What did you think of the game? Leave your reviews on the store page to support the game on Steam and help others decide if it's right for them.

notes.title: A Closer Inspection: Find the Poison, the Proof, the Killer
notes.notes:
[h2]Find The Poison[/h2]

Play the yearly family quiz and team-up with the members of your choice where you will secretly interrogate them via on-screen choices. Get familiar with the family, someone must still have the poison? It's a who's who of new and familiar FMV actors including Andy Buckley (The Office), Robbie Kay (Pinocchio), Al Weaver ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1107790/The_Complex/]The Complex[/url]) and Georgia Small ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353270/Five_Dates/]Five Dates[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490840/Bloodshore/]Bloodshore[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/336b352ac85901691ab05e86b68ae5c3ec59a9b8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/ec348fdffe6a1e250e94f653192f63526d0908dc.gif[/img]

[h2]Find The Proof[/h2]

Throughout the game you will collect evidence on each character, which you will use to determine who the killer is. At the end of each game round you will have a chance to review the evidence of the person you teamed up with. HINT: You can also review each character's evidence in the main menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/5c1745419787c3edc62475651a497cc2ed2274a6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/a3b2f687ff62a1d29ab34c44e61337e469e1e725.jpg[/img]

[h2]Find The Killer[/h2]

So you think you know who poisoned Uncle Marcus? It's time to accuse them! As long as you've got enough evidence to support your accusation, at the end of the game you can accuse that member of the family. Regardless of whether you choose correctly or not, each character has their own story, their own secret, that will be discovered at the end of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/c0df7ba5f7a6218f1aac330ed4b96d8bdfcb8a7b.gif[/img]

[previewyoutube=zgPobVgVe30;full][/previewyoutube]
